proposed_widenings.name: ModifySpeedRider (MasteryEffect variant)
proposed_widenings.justification: Slow's on-hit effect reduces the target's Speed by 10 feet. The v4 atom `modify_speed` exists but MasteryEffect has no variant for it — only ModifyRollAdvantageRider, SaveGateRider, and GrantWeaponAttackRider are defined. A new MasteryEffect variant is needed: { kind: 'modify_speed'; delta: number; expiresOn: RiderExpiry }.
proposed_widenings.evidence: If you hit a creature with this weapon and deal damage to it, you can reduce its Speed by 10 feet until the start of your next turn.

proposed_widenings.name: RiderExpiry 'turn_start' variant
proposed_widenings.justification: Slow expires 'until the start of your next turn' — a clean turn-start expiry with no conditional 'OR target uses attack' clause. The existing 'target_uses_or_turn_start' is Sap-specific (adds the OR clause); 'end_of_next_turn' is the wrong boundary. A new { kind: 'turn_start' } variant of RiderExpiry is needed for mastery riders that simply last until the attacker's next turn starts.
proposed_widenings.evidence: you can reduce its Speed by 10 feet until the start of your next turn

proposed_widenings.name: Stacking cap on modify_speed rider (residue)
proposed_widenings.justification: Slow has a per-instance stacking cap: 'the Speed reduction doesn't exceed 10 feet' even if hit multiple times. No surface type currently models a stacking cap on a rider effect. This is likely runtime-enforcement metadata rather than a new atom, but it has no current surface representation.
proposed_widenings.evidence: If the creature is hit more than once by weapons that have this property, the Speed reduction doesn't exceed 10 feet.

notes: The on_hit_trigger family fits cleanly. Trigger (weapon_hit, any weapon), optional flag, and the v4 modify_speed atom all exist. The two blockers are (1) MasteryEffect has no modify_speed variant, and (2) RiderExpiry has no clean turn_start variant — the existing target_uses_or_turn_start carries the Sap-specific 'OR target uses attack' clause that Slow does not have. The stacking cap is an additional gap worth tracking but is lower priority (runtime concern).
